summary: Deleted users disappear, your correlation decisions apply everywhere, and reports are never quietly incomplete.

fixes.title: Deleted users are no longer shown active
fixes.text: Users that Entra ID lists as deleted are retired at once, and their findings close as asset deleted, never as fixed. Expect a one-time retirement of such users after this update.

fixes.title: Your correlation decisions apply to assets
fixes.text: Your merge and split decisions now apply to the assets themselves. Findings that move with a split asset never read as fixed.

fixes.title: Reports are never quietly incomplete
fixes.text: A report that could not read all the data it needs now ends as not complete and keeps its last complete result, instead of finishing with empty columns.

fixes.title: Large reports keep going while progressing
fixes.text: A large report that does not fit in one answer keeps going while it makes progress, and says plainly whether the service was briefly unavailable or the report is too large.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Users synchronised from Active Directory are no longer counted twice, so the users count can fall. A failed run during an identity move is no longer blamed on the new identity.
